Module 04: Transcription & Palaeography — Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Differentiate diplomatic (graphemically faithful) from normalized editorial transcription and apply standard editorial conventions to damaged surfaces.
  • Transcribe a full manuscript folio by hand in plain text to establish an authoritative ground-truth reference for downstream evaluation.
  • Configure and train Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) baseline and character models using Transkribus, identifying bounding polygons, baselines, and line-order hierarchies.
  • Benchmark and audit Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and LLM-assisted transcription outputs against manual ground truth, quantifying Character Error Rate (CER) and diagnosing hallucination modes.
